messages:
Maya: Noticing a new failure mode in the nightly NetSuite sync - several invoices rejected because invoice.total != sum(lines). Stripe shows total 12.34 but our CSV sum is 12.33 (rounding). NetSuite returns LINE_SUM_MISMATCH.

billing-bot: nightly-sync failed: 03:05 UTC - netsuite_api 422 "LINE_SUM_MISMATCH" (sync id: ns-2026-04-10-03)

Luis: Hmm, we added per-line truncation to 2 decimals in billing-exporter last week to match display; that truncation loses fractional cents when lines have many prorated pieces. Should be using banker's rounding or carry remainder to last line.

Maya: Example CSV rowset I grabbed for invoice inv_R7: lines: [4.115 -> 4.11, 4.115 -> 4.11, 4.11] total displayed 12.33 but Stripe stored 12.34. NetSuite validates AR totals strictly and rejects mismatch.

Priya: Finance put the affected invoices on hold. Can we stop nightly sync until fix is live? We need a remediation plan because several customers got payment retries blocked.

Luis: I'll revert the truncation commit and implement a rounding accumulator: round each line to cents but adjust the last line by the leftover to ensure sum matches source total. Add unit tests for various split patterns. Deploy to canary.

Maya: Also add a pre-flight check in exporter: if sum(lines) != source_total then fail-fast and send to rounding-quarantine queue instead of emitting bad CSV. That way NetSuite won't see bad rows.

billing-bot: quarantine-queue: 9 invoices moved to rounding-quarantine-2026-04-10.

Priya: Created TICKET-4378: "Rounding truncation caused NetSuite LINE_SUM_MISMATCH - backfill & retry". Finance will approve re-emits for cleared invoices and manual adjustments for any that already attempted payment.

Luis: Canary metrics look good (100 sample invoices with mixed prorations matched source totals). I'll coordinate a backfill run once finance signs off.

Maya: Thx. Please attach canary logs and the unit test matrix to the ticket. Ops, can you keep the nightly sync disabled until we confirm backfill window?

ops-bot: scheduled-job disabled: nightly-sync (id: ns-2026-04-10-03) by Maya.

Priya: Finance will review and sign off on re-emits for the 9 quarantined invoices. If CS hears from customers about failed charges, escalate to me.

Luis: Follow-ups: add CI check for line-sum parity, add monitoring alert if >2 LINE_SUM_MISMATCH in a run, and include rounding notes in exporter README.

Maya: Postmortem scheduled tomorrow. Good catch, Luis. :white_check_mark:
